{{dablink|For the similarly named Shadowspawn creature, see [[cafar]].}}
A '''''capar''''' is an animal found in the [[Aiel Waste]]. It resembles a large hairy boar but its snout is pointed and its toes have claws.

[[Valan Luca]] has a ''capar'' on display as a part of the menagerie in his [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|traveling show]].{{ref/book|5|13}}
